source: M08 §6.2 and §6.6: EN and BN templates for every default channel of the catalogue codes built so far (Phase 1, M06). in_app: subject = title. email: subject + plain text (HTML is wrapped at send time). SMS: max 3 segments. v2 adds the M07 payout templates. v3 adds the M02 KYC templates. v4 adds the M05 moderation templates (MOD_*). v5 adds the M21 esports templates (ESPORTS_*). v6: the M09 GROUND_* codes and the M02 BUSINESS_DOC_* codes.
